title.ja: プラネテューヌの女神[ネプテューヌ]

1.overview: After long years of war, peace has finally come to Gamindustri. As usual, though, the goddess of Planeptune is a little TOO peaceful--gaming is so much more fun than running a country! With the Console Wars over, will the next war be Neptune vs. inertia?!
1.summary:
After long years of war, peace has finally come to Gamindustri. As usual, though, the goddess of Planeptune is a little TOO peaceful--gaming is so much more fun than running a country! With the Console Wars over, will the next war be Neptune vs. inertia?!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ルウィーの兇行[ペロリスト]

2.overview: A day at the amusement park takes a sinister turn when two (mostly) innocent girls are kidnapped by a monster. And then a stranger with a camera crew barges into the Basilicom, and things kinda start to get weird.
2.summary:
A day at the amusement park takes a sinister turn when two (mostly) innocent girls are kidnapped by a monster. And then a stranger with a camera crew barges into the Basilicom, and things kinda start to get weird.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: リーンボックスの週末[ガールズナイト]

3.overview: Vert offers to throw all the goddesses a party in Leanbox, but when they arrive, she's busy with another kind of party. Then, just as the celebration finally begins, the Basilicom staff reports a monster invasion that has all the CPUs leaping to action.
3.summary:

title.en: The Resolve (Turn) of the Younger Sisters

4.overview: Nepgear, Uni, Rom, and Ram are instructed to go back home after their sisters' capture, but they can't bear to leave their families behind in danger. To get back their sisters, they'll have to learn how to transform into goddesses themselves.
4.summary:

Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 女神たちの共鳴[オーバーリミット]
title.en: The Resonance (Limit Break) of the Goddesses

5.overview: It's the little sisters to the rescue as Nepgear leads the charge against Arfoire's monsters. But with their older sisters sinking further into darkness every second, can they do anything in time to help?
5.summary:
It`s the little sisters to the rescue as Nepgear leads the charge against Arfoire`s monsters. But with their older sisters sinking further into darkness every second, can they do anything in time to help?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ラステイションの秘密[ユア・アイズ・オンリー]

6.overview: Noire's up to something at night behind closed doors, and Uni's dying to know what it is. Luckily, she's got tech expert Nepgear to help her out. But as it turns out, Uni's not the only one interested in what Noire's doing...
6.summary:

title.ja: 復讐の果実[ディープパープル]

7.overview: The gang learns more about Plutia, and Neptune's very worst, most hated enemy appears.
7.summary:

title.ja: 禁断の楽園[アイランド]...... であんなことやこんなことやっちゃったりやられちゃったりでもしかするとポロリどころかペロリまであるかもしれなくていや~んネプテューヌ恥ずかしい~みたいな!
title.en: The Paradise (Island) Forbidden ...on Which People Will Do Things to Other People and Forget Wardrobe Malfunction Because There Might Even Be Some Tonguing and It`ll Be Like "Oh No, Neptune Is So Embarrassed~~"!
title.x-jat: Kindan no Island... de Anna Koto ya Konna Koto Yacchattari Yararechattari de Moshika Suru to Porori dokoro ka Perori made Aru ka mo Shirenakute Iyaan Neptune Hazukashiii Mitai na!

8.overview: The CPUs visit an adults-only island full of forbidden pleasures--for work reasons, of course. Meanwhile, Peashy is stuck at home sulking after a fight with Neptune.
8.summary:

title.ja: エディンの挑戦[リベリオン]

9.overview: Neptune's maybe having a tiny bit of trouble bouncing back, and Plutia's maybe getting a tiny bit irritated about it. Soon, though, Gamindustri finds itself facing a problem even bigger than Plutia's rage...

title.ja: 忘却の戦線[コンフリクト]

10.overview: Eden acts on its bold proclamation and invades Planeptune, but Neptune is too upset to fight, leaving Nepgear on her own. The other CPUs aren't able to run much interference, though, because they've got Eden problems of their own too.

title.ja: 古からの使者[アグレッサー]

11.overview: All the problems with Eden are over, and the world is finally at peace again--but not everyone is happy about that. Now the nations' Shares are drastically unbalanced, and that never leads to anything good...

12.overview: It's the final battle, and the fate of Gamindustri is on the line!

title.ja: 約束の永遠[トゥルーエンド]
title.en: The Promised Happily Ever After (True End)

S1.overview: When all the little sisters get stuck in Bad Ending loops, the CPUs must search far and wide for the cure--whatever dimension it happens to be in!
